description: This file contains utility functions for rendering HTML responses related to admin UI and environment variable instructions in a FastAPI application.

methods.name: show_missing_vars_in_env
methods.description: Generates an HTML response indicating missing environment variables for the application.

methods.name: missing_keys_form
methods.description: Returns an HTML form template displaying instructions for setting environment variables, with placeholders for missing keys.

methods.name: admin_ui_disabled
methods.description: Returns an HTML response indicating that the admin UI is disabled, with instructions to enable it.
